stunned.title: STUNNED
stunned.wakeUp: When you regain consciousness, the corridor is empty.
stunned.flavor: You get up. Slowly. The void spared you — this time.

captured.title: CAPTURED
captured.theirsNow: Everything they find is theirs now.
captured.options: You can serve your sentence, pay bail, bribe a guard, or attempt an escape.
captured.costWarning: Serving your sentence has a cost. So does freedom.

fled.title: FLED
fled.running: You run. You don't look back.
fled.byEnemy: {{name}} shouts behind you. You can't hear anything anymore.
fled.shipStarts: Your ship starts before the doors close.
fled.flavor: Surviving is also a form of victory.
